_meta.what: Every merged-PR title returned by the recorded title searches, plus real titles seen outside those windows. `model_support` is present only where the classification was hand-verified against the PR diff.
_meta.finding: No real merged vLLM or SGLang PR title in this corpus contains an architecture class name (XxxForCausalLM); a GitHub search for `ForCausalLM in:title` over all merged PRs in both repos returns 0 hits. Titles carry marketing names ('GLM-5.3-Flash', 'Kimi K3'); architecture names have to come from the diff.
